sloka: पाशमुद्गरदण्डैश्च निखातैश्चापरे तदा।कदनं कपिवीराणां चक्रुस्ते रजनीचराः ।। ६.७९.५ ।।
transliteration: pāśamudgaradaṇḍaiśca nikhātaiścāpare tadā।kadanaṁ kapivīrāṇāṁ cakruste rajanīcarāḥ ।। 6.79.5 ।।

translations.english: Those prowlers, then ight rangers discharging javelins, swords, maces, spears, lances, small swords, bhindi Palas, shafts, nooses, mallets and staff and other weapons on the lions among the monkeys, caused destruction.
